issue.title: Bug: test_bgp_command Failed to run docker command

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

The test is failed because it try to run `docker exec -i bgp vtysh -c "show bgp ipv4 all"` on IPv6 testbed.
Which it will return nothing. It's technically not failed to run.

### Steps to Reproduce

Have a IPv6 topo testbed, then run:
`yanmo@sonic-mgmt-yanmo_debug:/var/src/sonic-mgmt-int/tests$ ./run_tests.sh -c bgp/test_bgp_command.py  -n vms71-t0-7060x6-3 -i ../ansible/str4,../ansible/veos -q 1 -u `

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Right now it will run IPv4 test on IPv6 testbed.
Expected :
Since the test is already pre-set to have IPv4 and IPv6 run.
It should not run IPv4 test on IPv6 testbed.

### Relevant log output

```shell
bgp/test_bgp_command.py::test_bgp_network_command[str4-7060x6-64pe-10-ipv4] FAILED [ 50%]
bgp/test_bgp_command.py::test_bgp_network_command[str4-7060x6-64pe-10-ipv6] PASSED [100%]DEBUG:tests.conftest:[log_custom_msg] item: <Function test_bgp_network_command[str4-7060x6-64pe-10-ipv6]>
INFO:root:Can not get Allure report URL. Please check logs

=================================== FAILURES ===================================
______________ test_bgp_network_command[str4-7060x6-64pe-10-ipv4] ______________

duthosts = [<MultiAsicSonicHost str4-7060x6-64pe-10>]
enum_rand_one_per_hwsku_frontend_hostname = 'str4-7060x6-64pe-10'
ip_version = 'ipv4'

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("ip_version", ["ipv4", "ipv6"])
    def test_bgp_network_command(
        duthosts, enum_rand_one_per_hwsku_frontend_hostname, ip_version
    ):
        """
        @summary: This test case is to verify the output of "show ip bgp network" command
        if it matches the output of "docker exec -i bgp vtysh -c show bgp ipv4 all" command
        """
        duthost = duthosts[enum_rand_one_per_hwsku_frontend_hostname]
        if ip_version == "ipv4":
            bgp_network_cmd = "show ip bgp network"
            bgp_docker_cmd = 'docker exec -i bgp vtysh -c "show bgp ipv4 all"'
        elif ip_version == "ipv6":
            bgp_network_cmd = "show ipv6 bgp network"
            bgp_docker_cmd = 'docker exec -i bgp vtysh -c "show bgp ipv6 all"'

        bgp_network_result = duthost.shell(bgp_network_cmd)
        bgp_network_output = bgp_network_result["stdout"]
        pytest_assert(
            bgp_network_result["rc"] == 0,
            "{} return value is not 0, output={}".format(
                bgp_network_cmd, bgp_network_output
            ),
        )
        pytest_assert(
            "*=" in bgp_network_output or "*>" in bgp_network_output,
            "Failed to run '{}' command, output={}".format(
                bgp_network_cmd, bgp_network_output
            ),
        )

        bgp_docker_result = duthost.shell(bgp_docker_cmd)
        bgp_docker_output = bgp_docker_result["stdout"]
        pytest_assert(
            bgp_docker_result["rc"] == 0,
            "{} return value is not 0, output:{}".format(bgp_docker_cmd, bgp_docker_output),
        )
>       pytest_assert(
            "*=" in bgp_docker_output or "*>" in bgp_docker_output,
            "Failed to run '{}' command, output={}".format(
                bgp_docker_cmd, bgp_docker_output
            ),
        )
E       Failed: Failed to run 'docker exec -i bgp vtysh -c "show bgp ipv4 all"' command, output=
```

resolution.title: Skip IPv4 BGP network command test in IPv6 topology
resolution.description: ### Description of PR Summary: Fixes #19605 ### Type of change - [ ] Bug fix - [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement) - [ ] New Test case - [ ] Skipped for non-supported platforms - [x] Test case improvement ### Back port request - [ ] 202205 - [ ] 202305 - [ ] 202311 - [ ] 202405 - [x] 202411 - [x] 202505 ### Approach #### What is the motivation for this PR? To support IPv6 topo. Remove unnecessary fail and reduce total test run time. #### How did you do it? Enable topo check when it tries to run IPv4 test. If topo is IPv6 but test is IPv4, the test will skip. #### How did you verify/test it? Ran on local testbed to verify. #### Any platform specific information? #### Supported testbed topology if it's a new test case? ### Documentation
